---
title: "Boundaries"
---

The Workbench separates reusable infrastructure from project-specific theory. This boundary is methodological, not merely organizational.

## Shared Infrastructure

Shared code belongs under:

```text
src/fspp_workbench/
```

Shared modules may store, validate, version, compare, audit, and publish evidence. They must not contain Sacrificial Debt-specific theoretical categories except through generic extension interfaces.

## Project Theory

Sacrificial Debt theory belongs under:

```text
src/fspp_workbench/projects/sacrificial_debt/
projects/sacrificial-debt/research/
projects/sacrificial-debt/codebook/
```

## Import Rule

Shared infrastructure must not import `fspp_workbench.projects.*`.

Project modules may import shared infrastructure.

## Canonical And Generated Data

Canonical records live in project data, corpus/provenance manifests, research files, and codebook files.

Generated outputs live under generated-output directories and must be rebuildable.
